sources.authority_reason: Cho et al. introduce the gated recurrent hidden unit.
sources.inspection_note: Actually read §2.1–2.3, especially §2.3 Eqs 5–8 and Fig2 (PDF pp2–3): current input and previous hidden state feed reset/update gates and a new hidden state. The lesson states this mechanism, not a guarantee of exact memory. PyTorch intentionally places the reset gate differently; its installed official implementation is checked separately.

sources.title: Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.authority_reason: Bengio et al. directly analyze target-token training versus generated-token inference.
sources.inspection_note: Actually read abstract, §1, §2.1 Eqs1–3, §2.2–2.4 (PDF pp1–3): training uses previous true targets; inference uses model predictions; EOS appended to targets and emitted to terminate. No scheduled-sampling benefit is asserted for this lesson.

sources.title: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
sources.authority_reason: Original VQ-VAE paper defines nearest-code lookup and separate autoregressive prior.
sources.inspection_note: Actually read §3.1 Eqs1–2 (nearest embedding and decoder input), §3.2 Eq3 and its final paragraph (PDF pp3–4; cached text lines133–230). The paper learns codec first and fits an autoregressive prior afterwards. Supports representation/reconstruction versus prior generation separation; the lesson is only a manually fixed raw-block table, not a trained VQ-VAE.

sources.details: 800 samples / 8000 samples/s=0.1s=100ms. Each 0.2s event needs1600 samples=2 blocks and 0.1s pause needs800=1 block; total5 blocks=4000 samples=0.5s. At positive signal/error energy SNR=10log10(E_signal/E_error); SNR10dB means ratio10, hence E_error/E_signal=0.1. Complete solvable-family success is sum_i 1[whole output matches gold program]/N over all N predeclared cases; transfer, parse failure, silence or wrong output each contribute0 but remain in N. Keeping failures cannot improve this ratio by removing hard examples. Family-equal SNR means (1/F)sum_f SNR_f (or family means if variants exist), a declared aggregation convention. Codec SNR and gold-conditioned success do not imply whole-chain success: a perfect codec plus85/100 gold successes can coexist with0/100 whole successes if A conditions every actual case on the wrong sound family. Thresholds10dB,85%,80%,100% and tolerances5%,30ms are design values, not inferred achieved performance. A fixed condition target with phase0 is deterministic; evaluating codec reconstruction at a different original phase is a different task and must retain that phase.
